content.short: Maia DAO is an advanced decentralized protocol designed for seamless defi yield aggregators within the Web3 ecosystem on Arbitrum.
content.description: Maia DAO is the yield powerhouse of Metis, providing a suite of decentralized finance products. Operating at the forefront of the DeFi Dapps sector, Maia DAO redefines how users interact with defi yield aggregators. The protocol leverages the advanced capabilities of Arbitrum to provide a seamless, non-custodial experience that guarantees user sovereignty. Its architecture is explicitly built for scale, accommodating high throughput and complex decentralized operations. With a strong commitment to open-source principles, Maia DAO stands out as a crucial utility in the modern Web3 tech stack.
